note: Sources and digest pins for the two model artifacts the Dockerfile's models stage fetches at image-build time. URLs are tried in order until one answers. An empty sha256 means unpinned: the stage still fetches the canonical URL, records the fetched digest beside the model and stamps MODEL_PROVENANCE=fetched_unpinned, so no surface claims a verification that did not happen. Run scripts/pin_models.sh once on a networked machine to fetch both artifacts, fill these digests and commit the file; the no-build-args image build then verifies them (a mismatch fails the build) and stamps MODEL_PROVENANCE=fetched. A build-arg (LONGWATCH_MODEL_URL/_SHA256, LONGWATCH_FACE_MODEL_URL/_SHA256) overrides this file; passing LONGWATCH_MODEL_URL=none disables the fetch deliberately and the in-repo contract fixture is used.
